source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC console, upload data, remove data and repeat.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data upload normally and no BMC SEL error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; manual cold/high-rail BMC transfer stress.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED because path/protocol/file/bounds/storage limits and recovery were undefined.

old_problem: The source omitted transfer path, protocol, deterministic payload, loop bound and storage protection, but these can be mandatory runtime/project bindings around a clearly defined BMC scratch-transfer purpose.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits a project-bound BMC method while forbidding guessed OEM paths, ED-09 keeps chamber work manual, ED-15 requires signed integrity/service limits, and ED-17 preserves SEL evidence. The review defines a bounded scratch-only contract; execution remains gated until it is approved.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row43 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3080 and actual next row44/history3081 were read.
Only an approved non-system scratch path with reserve/wear budget may be used; system firmware partitions and arbitrary removal are excluded.
A deterministic file/hash and explicit repetition count or duration/rate make upload/remove measurable without inventing source semantics.
Per-iteration hash, free-space and BMC service health plus cold trace and cleanup are required; no action ran.

test_case.test_name: Bounded BMC scratch-file upload/remove stress at 0C/+5% rails
test_case.purpose: Exercise the approved BMC transfer service and scratch storage repeatedly under cold/high-rail margin without integrity, capacity, wear, service or platform failure.
required_package: BMC firmware/storage identity and approved scratch path
Pinned authenticated protocol/account and deterministic file/hash
Signed loop bound, reserve/wear and service/integrity limits
Cold/high-rail abort, cleanup and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/+5% conditions and, using only the approved account/protocol/scratch path, perform the signed bounded upload-hash-remove loop while recording storage reserve and BMC service health, then verify cleanup, warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: Every authorized iteration preserves the expected hash, removes only its scratch object, stays above reserve/wear/service limits, produces no disallowed event and leaves BMC services/storage healthy after cleanup.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the pre-approved path, payload, bound and measurable integrity/service evidence. Arbitrary files, unbounded repetition, system paths or 'upload returned success' alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: BMC-owner approval of scratch path/protocol/account and bounds
Preserve SEL/history; least privilege and non-sensitive payload
Abort on low reserve, mismatch, service loss, storage/environment fault
No auto-retry; safe cleanup and dry warm-up
expected_evidence: File size/hash and signed loop specification
test_case.recovery: Stop without further writes, preserve evidence, remove only confirmed test objects if safe, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, verify BMC services/storage and use owner recovery if cleanup fails.

source_conflict.reason: The operation is consistent; missing details become signed execution bindings.

blocked.reason: A scratch-only bounded contract supplies a safe parameterized method without guessing values.
